sources.rationale: Retain existing pinned Docling converter/options; use native cells instead of donor Markdown. No default converter fallback.
Preserve existing isolated subprocess; reject donor exception/log forwarding and implicit option fallback.
Exact original asset identity, source region and separate reencoded preview lineage; no current-source substitution or caption-based identity.
No emitted assets does not prove no visuals. Preserve failed/unsupported/skipped/budget diagnostics, no whole-document completeness inference.
Rebase multi-page continuity and physical locators onto exact source-declared table ID. MinerU slicing/cloud runtime rejected.
Rebase explicit headers/units/notes and caption-versus-generated descriptions; separate original/preview byte digests and dependency refs.

newCodeRationale: The donor deliberately defers structured Docling IR. KnowKit needs schema-closed immutable spans, explicit source-reported continuity, bounded nonoverlapping cells, confidence metadata without guessing symbols, and separately labelled generated assets. The exact docling-pdf-structure-v1 profile binds retention mapping and inherited code/weights qualification without changing the old text-profile fingerprint. Existing structural chunking is reused for indivisible row-group budgets; header IDs are corrected to resolve within their own IR table.
gaps: Docling text profile retains table/formula recognition disabled; mapping native API fixtures does not qualify a recognition capability.
Rich cells and ambiguous multi-page Docling cell geometry remain unsupported. Multi-page continuity is retained only when explicitly supplied by the source adapter.

Rendered source-page previews are generated assets with exact page regions; original embedded visual bytes are explicitly unavailable in the native profile. The retention API separately preserves supplied original and reencoded preview bytes.
No optional external adapter is implemented or qualified by these contract fixtures.
planMirror: Plan mutation is forbidden by result_contract; the coordinator/registrar owns the plan receipt mirror.
